## Bearer

RaceDetailViewModel — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racedetail/RaceDetailViewModel.kt

## Trigger

The rename dialog's "Enregistrer" tap, in onRenameConfirmed — observed

## Today

onRenameConfirmed calls `raceRepository.rename(raceId, name)` and discards
the `Result`, then always clears `renameFieldValue` and closes the
dialog — a rename outside RaceRepository's 1-40 trimmed-character bound
fails silently, the dialog closing as if it had saved.
`PhoneStringResources.Rename` (app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/text/PhoneStringResources.kt)
carries only `title`/`fieldLabel`/`cancel`/`save` — no key for a
rejection or constraint message. By contrast the watch home screen's
permission reminders already follow the pattern this gap expects: each
renders real catalogue text and a re-request action —
`WatchStringResources.Permission.reminder`/`action` and
`Connectivity.reminder`/`action`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/ui/text/WatchStringResources.kt),
both backed by real resources (`permission_reminder`,
`connectivity_permission_reminder` in
app-wear/src/main/res/values/strings.xml), rendered in HomeScreen.kt and
wired to `onSensorPermissionReminderClicked`/`onConnectivityPermissionReminderClicked`,
which call `requestAgain()`.

## Expected

onRenameConfirmed reads the `rename` call's `Result`; on failure it keeps
the dialog open and shows a constraint message naming the 1-40 character
bound, backed by a new key added to `PhoneStringResources.Rename`.
